question.text: A PM rebalances to GIVE the client LTCG tax benefit by holding positions beyond 12 months. Which rebalancing approach best supports this?

explanation.text: The Logic: Minimise realised short-term gains by holding past 1-year LTCG boundary. Use inflows to rebalance instead of selling. The Trap: Aggressive/daily triggers frequent STCG. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 10, Topic 21. Manager's Pro-Tip: Track holding-period per lot; time-bound exits past 12 months for LTCG rate advantage.
